MASTER OF SCIENCE IN COMPUTER INFORMATION SYSTEMS

Master Information Systems for Strategic Business Success

Develop the expertise to deliver timely and actionable information for critical business decision-making with a flexible program for working professionals.

Begin Your Journey
Request Info

Estimated Annual Tuition: $15,138 (based on one academic year)

2 years Degree Duration | 39 Credit Credit Hours | 13 Courses

Develop Your Strategic Technology Leadership

Information Systems Expertise: Master data modeling, networkplanning, comparative system development methodologies, and database administration to build a solid foundation.

Strategic Management Skills: Learn to align technology initiatives with business objectives through courses in operations management, strategic management, and organizational

Practical Implementation Capabilities: Develop, analyze, and implement operational strategic plans based on organized data with business applications of tech resources.

Project Management Focus: Gain the skills to lead IT projects successfully, from planning and monitoring to scheduling and risk assessment.

Apply Now

Program Structure: 

The Master of Science in Computer Information Systems requires 39 semester credit hours:

  • Core Courses: 33 credits
  • Concentration Courses: 6 credits

Program Duration: 

  • 2 years or shorter depending on your course load.

Format Options:

  • Fully online and hybrid classes
  • Eight-week accelerated course sessions
  • Multiple start dates throughout the year

Core Courses:

  • Comparative System Development Methodologies
  • Data Modeling and Database Administration
  • Information Systems Planning
  • Managerial Economics
  • IT Project Management
  • Strategic Management of Technology
  • JAVA Programming
  • Network Planning and Administration

The Master's Capstone Experience 

As the culmination of your MSCIS program, you’ll complete a comprehensive Capstone Project that: Requires consultation with a company of your choice, Evaluates current corporate strategy, Develops a plan to improve competitive position, Integrates management and organizational knowledge, Demonstrates your ability to solve real business problems.

The Capstone Project represents the summation of your work at California Miramar University and provides tangible evidence of your readiness for executive roles.

Admission Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution with minimum 2.5 GPA
  • Official academic transcripts
  • Transfer students welcome from accredited institutions
  • International students with equivalent education (NACES evaluation required)
  • English proficiency requirements for non-native speakers
  • Prerequisites may be required for those without business background
  • We do NOT require standardized test scores like GRE, GMAT, nor resume, or essay.

OPT Opportunities

Increase your eligibility
to work in the US

Not only does this program increase your employability worldwide, but you can also be eligible for up to three years of post-graduation work authorization (OPT) in the US. You must study in the US for the full year of your MSCIS and go on to work in a STEM finance-related field. Non-STEM graduates are only eligible for a maximum of one year OPT in the US.

Frequently Asked Questions

Program Basics

What degree will I earn?

Upon successful completion of the program, you will earn an Master of Science in Computer Information Systems from California Miramar University.

How many credits are required to complete the program?

The MSCIS program requires 39 credit hours.

How long does it take to complete the program?

The standard program duration is 2 years, though it can be completed sooner with a transfer credit evaluation.

 
 
What format options are available?

We offer flexible classes designed for your busy schedule, including:

  • Online options
  • Hybrid formats
  • Multiple start dates throughout the year
Where are you located?

Our locations include:

  • San Diego
  • La Puente
  • San Jose

Admission Requirements

What are the basic admission requirements?

To be considered for admission to the BSBA program, you need:

  • Minimum 2.5 GPA
  • Official academic Bachelor transcripts
  • English proficiency (for non-native speakers)
 
Can I transfer credits from another institution?

Yes, you can transfer up to 6 credit hours from other accredited institutions. 

Do you accept international students?

Yes

 
 
Are there any prerequisites?
 
Depending on your background, you may need to complete prerequisites including:
Course No. Course Title Credit Hour
CIS 3700 Introduction to Java 3
BUS 1015 Computer Essentials: Digital and Virtual Environment 3
BUS 3151 Business Statistics 3

 

Enrollment Support

When can I start?
Classes start every two months, providing multiple entry points throughout the year.
Is there a deadline for each enrollment period?

Yes, our academic calendar consists of six class sessions that span across eight week courses.

Attached are the following deadlines:

  • Summer 1: May 1, 2026
  • Summer 2: June 26, 2026
  • Fall 1: August 28, 2026
  • Fall 2: October 30, 2026
What support is available to students?
We offer personalized attention to ensure your success in the program. Our admissions advisors are ready to help you map your educational path.
How do I apply or get more information?
You can begin your journey by clicking the "Begin Your Journey" button on our website, or by contacting our admissions office directly.

Curriculum and Learning

What skills will I develop in this program?
The MSCIS program develops your expertise in:
  • Information Systems: data modeling, network planning, system development methodologies, database administration
  • Strategic Management: aligning technology with business objectives
  • Practical Implementation: developing and implementing operational strategic plans
  • Project Management: planning, monitoring, scheduling, and risk assessment for IT projects
What core technology skills will I learn?
Core technology skills include:
  • JAVA Programming
  • Network Planning and Administration
  • Data Modeling and Database Administration
  • Information Systems Planning
  • IT Project Management
  • Comparative System Development Methodologies
  • Strategic Management of Technology
 
Is there a capstone project?
Yes, the program culminates in a comprehensive Capstone Project that requires:
  • Consultation with a company of your choice
  • Evaluation of a current corporate technology strategy
  • Development of a plan to improve the organization's competitive position through information systems
  • Demonstration of your ability to solve real business problems with technology solutions

The Capstone Project may be presented as a traditional research paper, report, or as an innovative document that represents the summation of your work.

Career Prospects

What career paths are available to graduates?
MSCIS graduates pursue successful careers in various fields including:

Information Systems Leadership:

● Application Development Director

● Computing Services Director

● Information Systems Director

Technology Management:

● Information Systems Manager

● Information Technology Manager

● Technical Services Manager

Data Management:

● Data Processing Manager

● Database Administrator

● Information Systems Supervisor

How will this degree advance my career?
The MSCIS program prepares you for:

● Career advancement into roles like IT Director or Information Systems Manager

● Leadership development to lead technology initiatives

● Creating strategic value by translating technical capabilities into business advantages

● Making organizational impact by designing information systems that support effective decision-making
